# ConsultChimps

> Deterministic, local-first document operations for consultants: consolidate,
> merge, and split Excel workbooks; inspect and populate PowerPoint templates;
> split and merge PDFs. All processing happens locally: files never leave the
> machine. Requires Node.js 22 or later.

## Run with zero setup

Download one file from the latest GitHub release and run it with Node. No npm
access or package resolution is required:

    node consultchimps.mjs --help
    node consultchimps.mjs sheets consolidate "*.xlsx" --output combined.xlsx --normalize-headers

Bundle asset: https://github.com/consultchimps/consultchimps/releases/latest
(`consultchimps.mjs`).

With npm access, `npx consultchimps --help` or `npm install -g consultchimps`
work the same.

## Notes for agents

- Every command accepts `--json` and then prints a machine-readable
  `{ok, result | error}` envelope on stdout; progress and diagnostics go to
  stderr and never mix into the JSON.
- Source files are never modified, and existing outputs are never overwritten
  unless `--force` is passed.
- Command groups: `sheets` (merge, consolidate, split), `pptx`
  (inspect-template, populate), `pdf` (split, merge). Run
  `node consultchimps.mjs <group> --help` for options with realistic examples.
- Expected failures exit nonzero with a stable error code in the JSON envelope.
